description: Sent to a student when a loan is renewed, confirming the new due date and how many renewals remain. Triggered by renewing a loan.
subject: Renewed: {{book_title}} now due {{new_due}}
body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Your loan has been renewed:

  Item:         {{book_title}}
  New due date: {{new_due}}
  Renewals:     {{renewals_count}} of {{max_renewals}} used

If someone else reserves this title we may recall it early, so do return it promptly once you're finished.

{{system_name}} Library
